{{Top|leg}}
The '''crelnut''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]]. They were tasty compared to the bland offerings available at the [[Krevk Settlement]], and could be easily cut with a knife.<ref name="BG">{{JournalCite|14|The Breath of Gelgelar}}</ref>
